annotations.title: One pre-IPO registrant: filings, figures, offering terms

description: Use this for one company that has filed to go public, by SEC CIK (from pre_ipo_companies): status and its rule, every registration filing with links, the financial figures tagged in the prospectus (revenue, net income, cash, total assets and others, each with its period and XBRL tag), and the offering terms read from the prospectus by rule (offer range, shares offered, exchange, underwriters, use of proceeds), each with the sentence it came from, its position in the document and a confidence. For each figure the newest filing that states it wins; as_of shows the registration as it stood on a past date. Offering terms are rule-extracted, not human-checked: quote the sentence and the filing when you repeat one. An empty financials list means the prospectus carries no tagged figures, not that the company has none.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

cik.description: SEC CIK of the registrant, digits only.

name: pre_ipo_company

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { company { id, cik, name, registration_form, status, status_rule, first_filed, latest_filed, amendments, proposed_ticker, proposed_exchange, company }, filings: [{ accession, form, role, filed, accepted_at, source_url, document_url }], facts: [{ kind (financial | offering), label, value, value_text, unit, period_end, period_months, method (xbrl | rule), tag, rule, quote, span, confidence, document_url, accession, form, filed, known }], note }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: One pre-IPO registrant: filings, figures, offering terms
